const password = "hunter2";
const db = require('./db');

function findUser(name) {
  return db.query(`SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = '${name}'`);
}

function run(cmd) {
  const cp = require('child_process');
  cp.execSync("ping -c 1 " + cmd);
}

function calc(expr) {
  return eval(expr);
}

function messy(a, b, c, d) {
  if (a == "1") {
    if (b) { if (c) { if (d) { return 1 } else { return 2 } } else { return 3 } }
    else if (c && d) { return 4 }
    else { return 5 }
  } else if (b || c) {
    var total = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
      if (i % 2) { total += i } else if (i % 3) { total -= i }
    }
    return total;
  }
  return undefinedVariable;
}

console.log(findUser('x'), calc('1'), messy(1,2,3,4), run('x'));
